 Hon'Ble Pankaj Bhatia, J.
1 . Supplementary affidavit filed today is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
3.
The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.371 of 2024, under Sections 376, 504, 506 IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act, Police Station Mall, District Lucknow.

3. The FIR in question was lodged alleging that the sister of the informant aged about 16 years was enticed by the applicant around 8 months ago and wrong was committed and the victim was carrying a fetus of 8 months.

Subsequently, the statement of the victim has been brought on record,
in which, she stated that she was in love with the applicant and a children was also born and subsequently after the birth of the child, the FIR in question was lodged.
4.
It is also stated that the child was given in adoption.
My attention is also drawn to the statement of the complainant to the effect that the age of the victim at the time of incident was 18 years.
5. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

6. Considering the two statements of the victim, prima facie, the relationship was found on account of the consent of the parties and the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is languishing in jail since 06.12.2024, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.
